Empoleon

Water Steel

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Empoleon is a Water/Steel-type Emperor Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 1.7 m tall and weighs 84.5 kg. It evolves from Prinplup. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (111), with a base stat total of 530.
